extraction.name: FOMO60K
extraction.description: A large-scale, heterogeneous dataset of 60,529 brain Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans from 13,900 sessions and 11,187 subjects, aggregated from 16 publicly available sources. The dataset includes both clinical- and research-grade images, multiple MRI sequences, and a wide range of anatomical and pathological variability, including scans with large brain anomalies. Minimal preprocessing was applied to preserve the original image characteristics while reducing barriers to entry for new users.
extraction.creator: Asbjørn Munk, Stefano Cerri, Jakob Ambsdorf, Julia Machnio, Sebastian Nørgaard Llambias, Vardan Nersesjan, Christian Hedeager Krag, Peirong Liu, Pablo Rocamora García, Mostafa Mehdipour Ghazi, Mikael Boesen, Michael Eriksen Benros, Juan Eugenio Iglesias, Mads Nielsen
extraction.publisher: University of Copenhagen, Pioneer Centre For AI
extraction.rai:dataCollection: FOMO60K is derived from 16 publicly available datasets, aggregating brain MRI scans with minimal preprocessing to retain raw characteristics. The dataset spans both clinical- and research-grade imaging, includes multiple MRI sequences (T1, T2, FLAIR, DWI, T1ce, PD, SWI, GRE, etc.), and captures anatomical and pathological diversity.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: In some cases, MRI sequence metadata was not available or could not be reliably identified; such scans are labeled as 'Unknown' or generically named scan_X.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Publicly available source datasets: MGH Wild, SOOP, BraTS-GEN, OASIS1, OASIS2, MSD Braintumor, IXI, NIMH, DLBS, IDEAS, ARC, MBSR, UCLA, QTAB, NKI, AOMIC ID1000.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: For DWI scans stored in 4D format, if a b=0 volume was available, it was extracted and saved separately. For the b=1000 shell, three diffusion-weighted volumes were selected based on their gradient directions being most closely aligned with the canonical x, y, and z axes, determined by cosine similarity between gradient vector (bvec) and orthogonal unit vectors. The corresponding volumes were averaged to produce a single representative 3D image. Subjects were shuffled to protect privacy and prevent identification of dataset sources.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: MRI preprocessing comprised three main steps: reorienting images to RAS (Right–Anterior–Superior) orientation, affine co-registration using the mri_coreg command from FreeSurfer 7.4.1 with default parameters (within each session scans were aligned to the image with the highest spatial resolution), and skull-stripping using SynthSeg (FreeSurfer 7.4.1). Skull-stripping was only applied when images were not already defaced or skull-stripped by the source dataset provider, or when visual inspection identified residual cranial features.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: SynthSeg (FreeSurfer 7.4.1) for skull-stripping segmentation masks; FreeSurfer 7.4.1 mri_coreg for affine co-registration.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset will continue to grow in future releases as additional cohorts and modalities become available. Preprocessing scripts are publicly available at https://github.com/fomo25/fomo60k-preprocessing for reproducibility.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Brain MRI scans of human subjects. Subjects have been shuffled to protect privacy and prevent easy identification of dataset sources. Images were defaced or skull-stripped for anonymization.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Intended to support the development and benchmarking of self-supervised learning methods in medical imaging at scale. The dataset can be used with no further pre-processing for pre-training. Accompanying code for self-supervised pretraining and finetuning is provided. Developed in parallel with the FOMO25 challenge at MICCAI 2025.
